integrity: All-exponent result is proved by a uniform integral Taylor congruence and branchwise 2-adic isometries; the checker is finite and supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Classical derangements and dyadic moduli only; no conclusion for odd prime powers or generalized derangements. The modulo-eight base case, basic period, valuation identities, and p-adic interpolation are attributed to prior work. No independent originality audit has occurred.
title: Exact residue fibres of derangement numbers modulo powers of two
